title: Word at a position
statement: For Boolean words $x,u$ and a natural number $r$, say that $u$ occurs at position $r$ in $x$ if, for every $i<|u|$, the entry of $x$ at position $r+i$ equals the entry of $u$ at position $i$, and $|x|=r+|u|$. Any out-of-range list lookup is interpreted as false.
